title: Chinese nationals detained after drone incursions at MacDill and Langley
summary: Jake Barber tells of Chinese nationals detained after drone incursions at MacDill and Langley, about 2024 at MacDill Air Force Base and Langley Air Force Base, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: MacDill Air Force Base and Langley Air Force Base

tellings.quote: Based on what we know from previous incursions at McDill and Langley Air Force Base this year as well, um, that there were Chinese nationals that were taken into custody.

plain: Jake Barber, a man who says he once flew a helicopter to retrieve a UFO, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that drones flew into the airspace over two US Air Force bases, MacDill and Langley, in 2024. According to Barber, what is known from those incursions is that Chinese nationals were taken into custody afterward, which would point to at least some mystery drones being a foreign government's doing rather than anything stranger.
